title: Hermeticize GPU runtime builds: remove optional image vendor deps and add cross-check suite
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Background:
We ship a unified GPU runtime image that currently pulls in a number of optional vendor libraries (nvjpeg, nvjpeg2, vendor FFT libs, a few image pre-/post-processing helpers) into the base artifact. These optional deps bloat images, increase surface area for symbol conflicts during heterogenous upgrades, and force private/on-prem customers to carry extra vendor license baggage.

Goal:
- Produce a hermetic base runtime container that contains only the mandatory GPU runtime and core inference libraries.
- Move optional image/vendor plugins into separately-versioned plugin artifacts (OCI images + runtime plugin manifest).
- Ensure runtime probes treat plugin absence as non-fatal (soft-degrade) and provide clear telemetry for missing-plugin fallbacks.
- Add a cross-check CI suite across representative SKUs (A100, H100, AdaGPU) that validates plugin-based behaviors and prevents regressions when optional plugins are absent.
- Keep end-to-end latency and memory within 2% of current baseline for critical paths that do not require the optional image plugins.

What we'll change:
1) Build system: split BUILD targets so that nvjpeg / image helpers are built into runtime-plugins/* instead of runtime/base. Update container Dockerfiles to produce base runtime + plugin images.
2) Runtime loader: add a plugin adapter that resolves plugin manifests by name and falls back to a no-op adapter when missing. Update startup probe to emit a WARNING not FAIL for missing optional plugins.
3) CI: introduce cross-check jobs (ci/gpu-crosscheck) that run a matrix of base+plugin combinations on A100/H100/Ada and fail on regressions (>2% latency or memory).
4) Signing & release: add deterministic build flags (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, pinned toolchains) and include a signed, reproducible plugin manifest for private deployments.
5) Docs & migration: write a migration guide for Dedicated/Private teams to adopt plugin artifacts and update Helm charts/OCI references.

Acceptance criteria:
- Base runtime image size reduced by >= 12% on x86_64-A100 build compared to current mainline image.
- No customer-facing behavior change for requests that do not require image plugins; perf regression <= 2%.
- CI cross-check runs for matrix in PRs touching build or runtime bootstrap code, and blocking merge on regressions.
- Migration guide delivered and referenced in release notes; internal infra team signs off on deployable replacement for Private builds.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Some internal feature tests implicitly depended on optional libs. Mitigation: create a compatibility shim in test harness and run full suite during canary.
- Risk: Plugin manifest signing adds release process complexity. Mitigation: prototype signing workflow in a one-off release and document steps for SRE.

Metrics to observe post-release:
- Base image size delta, plugin image size, and registry pull counts for plugin images.
- Frequency of plugin-missing warnings in telemetry.
- Cross-check CI pass rate and number of blocked PRs due to regression detection.
checklist: Audit current runtime image contents and produce list of optional libs
Identify and split BUILD targets for plugins vs base
Implement plugin adapter and soft-fail probe behavior
Add cross-check CI matrix job (A100/H100/Ada) and perf thresholds
Add deterministic build flags and reproducible image steps
Create migration guide and update Helm charts/Private deploy docs
Run canary on staging dedicated cluster and validate metrics
